headline: BOS @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 3.02 at CLE 3.50, with a projected total of 6.53. Batter research is strongest for Willson Contreras, Travis Bazzana, Jarren Duran, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
